summary: One tag in a TagGroup. Re-exported from react-stately's collection Item — `key` identifies it, children are its label.
useWhen: a child of TagGroup — it is not usable anywhere else

useInstead.when: it is a status label on its own

composition.note: A collection item, not a rendered component: TagGroup reads it to build the collection, so it never appears in the DOM itself. That is why it exposes no props of its own here — `key` and `textValue` are the collection's API.

guarantees: the row, cell and remove-button roles and names are supplied by TagGroup, not by this element
requires: a stable `key` — it is what `onRemove` hands back
`textValue` when the label is not plain text, so type-ahead and the remove button's name have words to use

antiPatterns.dont: array indexes as keys in a list that shrinks
antiPatterns.why: removing the first tag renumbers the rest, and the next removal drops the wrong one

antiPatterns.dont: wrapping Tag in a <div> or a fragment inside TagGroup
antiPatterns.why: TagGroup reads the collection from its direct children; a wrapper makes the tag invisible to it
